race.comment: WOOTTON VERNI (1) is going much better than the form guide might suggest. He ran on well fresh at 1400m then was wide on a fast pace second up. Fancy he was in the worse ground last time and a wet track brought out a big win in the Autumn. CAMPALDINO (3) faded in the G3 Naturalism last time, not having the turn of foot to sprint with them. His best is good enough and up to 2500m now can see his stamina kick in. LITZDEEL (11) was game in the G3 Archer here latest and gets in much better at the weights now. Can give this a shake. JENNIVAMOOSE (14) is looking to improve on her last-start third in the Archer Stakes won by Shockletz over 2500m at this track three weeks ago. Include.
